title: Sympathy for Delicious

text.lead: Sympathy for Delicious is a 2010 American drama film, and the directorial debut of Mark Ruffalo. Filming took place in Los Angeles.
text.plot: A newly paralyzed disc jockey (Thornton) gets more than he bargained for when he seeks out the world of faith healing.
text.cast:
- Christopher Thornton as "Delicious' Dean O'Dwyer
- Juliette Lewis as Ariel Lee
- Mark Ruffalo as Joe
- Laura Linney as Nina Hogue
- Orlando Bloom as The Stain
- Noah Emmerich as Rene Faubacher
- John Carroll Lynch as Healer
- Robert Wisdom as Prendell
- Dov Tiefenbach as Oogie
- Deantoni Parks as Chuck
- Sandra Seacat as Mrs. Matilda
text.production: Filming took place in Los Angeles, California, from 5 January to 28 February 2009.
